data.name: 11.11: Treat Yourself, Not Your Ex
data.headline: 11.11. Eleven hours. Treat yourself, not your ex.
data.benefit: 11.11: for eleven hours, treat yourself, not your ex. 8-class packs at 20% off from 11:11 am to 10:11 pm. One per person. Your ex isn’t invited.
data.rationale: Singles’ Day is now a shopping date in India. A one-day pack price brings in fence-sitters and members topping up, at a discount that never reaches memberships.
data.audience: Everyone: newcomers, pack buyers and members.
data.conditions: Spot offer, 20% cash. One per person. 11:11 am–10:11 pm on 11 Nov only.
data.kpi: Packs sold in 11 hours; pack buyers → membership by January.

data.name: Bride Squad, Assemble (Groom Can Come Too)
data.headline: Four of you, one wedding, zero excuses. Squad rates inside.
data.benefit: Bride squad, assemble: get 4 or more of you together and your 12-class packs are 12% off each, plus a private Squad Class that ends on a Sangeet routine. Groom can come too. We don’t judge.
data.rationale: November–December is shaadi season: brides, bridesmaids and families are motivated and arrive in groups. A group rate recruits several newcomers in one conversation, and the hosted class is time we already have, not cash.
data.audience: Wedding parties and friend groups (min 4, at least 2 new).
data.conditions: 4+ buyers on the same day, at least 2 new to P57. 12% cash + hosted class at list ≈ 18.7% (Kenkere 19.8%). No stacking.
data.kpi: Squads formed; new buyers from squads (target 50% of squad members).

data.name: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana (Come Back Before the Baraat)
data.headline: Shaadi mein zaroor aana. And to class before that.
data.benefit: Shaadi mein zaroor aana… and to class before that. Come back for 15% off, matching grip socks and our Sangeet Choreo Barre on 20 Nov: you’ll leave with a routine for the dance floor.
data.rationale: An event with a date beats a generic reminder, and the wedding season is the date. The socks and the class cost little and give a returner a reason to post.
data.conditions: Lapsed 61–365 days. Standard lapsed 15% + socks at list ≈ 18.5% (Kenkere 19.8%).

data.name: Black Friday Blind Box (No Duds)
data.headline: Black Friday, but every box is a winner. We checked.
data.benefit: Black Friday Blind Box: renew for 3, 6 or 12 months and pick a sealed box. Every box wins (extra days, guest passes, a private), and there are no duds. 26–29 Nov only.
data.rationale: Black Friday discounts train members to wait. A mystery bonus keeps the cash discount at the standard ladder (10/15/20%) and makes opening the box the content.
data.audience: Members renewing or upgrading; annual renewers due Nov–Jan.
data.conditions: 3M ≤19.1%, 6M ≤19.6% effective with the largest box; annual ≤24% with the Black Box. One box per plan. No discount on 1 Month.
data.kpi: 3M+ share of November renewal value; boxes opened on camera.

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Set up Bride Squad, Assemble (Groom Can Come Too) in Momence (2027-11-01 to 2027-11-30): Wedding season: a group of 4+ (at least 2 new to P57) buy 12-class packs together at 12% off each (Mumbai ₹17,325, Kenkere ₹11,550; packs valid 60 days) and get one hosted private Squad Class for the group, that ends on a choreographed Sangeet routine. Pop-ups: 8-class packs at 5% (₹6,584) + a hosted Pilates squad class. Grooms, cousins and the friend who “doesn’t do group fitness” all count.

steps.label: W2
steps.text: Weekly check: Bride Squad, Assemble (Groom Can Come Too): Squads formed; new buyers from squads (target 50% of squad members). | Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana (Come Back Before the Baraat): Reactivations; Sangeet Choreo attendance → purchase. | 11.11: Treat Yourself, Not Your Ex: Packs sold in 11 hours; pack buyers → membership by January. | Black Friday Blind Box (No Duds): 3M+ share of November renewal value; boxes opened on camera.

steps.label: W3
steps.text: Mid-month review against ₹11.2L: by the 15th aim for ~half of 57 new buyers (305 first visits), 39 renewals and 7 winbacks. Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
